summary: The prepared base already contains the issue-specific fix from upstream PR #31700: DeepSeek-V4 post-attention hidden states and token IDs use replicate rather than partial DP gathers, preventing already-reduced attention-TP replicas from being summed and scaled by attn_tp_size. Added regression coverage; no duplicate production change was made.

tests.what_was_measured: Three source-contract boundaries: replicated post-attention hidden-state gather, cloned replicate gathers for main and NextN token IDs, and preservation of the intentionally partial TBO gather. Result: 3 passed.
Failing-before fixture restoring the historical partial hidden-state gather and non-cloned token-ID inputs. Result: 2 failed, 1 passed; the independent TBO boundary remained valid.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-78d87a525bc7/venv/bin/python - <<'PY' # GPU gather-arithmetic and aliasing reference; see reports/j-78d87a525bc7/gfx950_gather_reference.log
tests.what_was_measured: On gfx950, summing replicated tensors scaled values exactly by attention-TP widths 2 and 4, leader-only replicate semantics had zero error, an input_ids view was mutated by in-place zeroing, and a clone preserved the source.

gpu_execution.evidence: A numerical gather-semantics and aliasing reference ran on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950. This was not a Marlin, full-model, or distributed execution.

remaining_limitations: Only one AMD gfx950 GPU was available; the report requires eight NVIDIA H800 GPUs with TP8/DP4.
DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 weights were unavailable, so generated-text accuracy was not reproduced locally.
NVIDIA Marlin kernels cannot be executed on the assigned AMD GPU.
No multi-GPU or multi-node claim is made; full-system evidence is limited to the documented upstream PR #31700 reproduction.
